discovery.standardTask: Scan the codebase and identify all specs, their SCs, and current test coverage
discovery.description: Discovery agent — reads issue, sizes work, writes ACs with evidence methods

marcus.standardTask: Add config/test.json with {name: test} and write a unit test for it
marcus.description: Principal engineer — implements code changes with TDD, writes tests, commits

quinn.standardTask: Validate the latest commit passes all tests and type checks, report AC evidence
quinn.description: QA engineer — tests as a brand-new user using Playwright MCP tools

rook.standardTask: Review lib/ for security issues: input validation, path traversal, command injection
rook.description: Security engineer — scans changed files for vulnerabilities

serena.standardTask: Review the scaffold-project.ts architecture and propose decomposition into modules
serena.description: Software architect — structural decisions, ADRs, module boundary review

aditi.standardTask: Design the CLI output format for test-brief compliance report with accessibility
aditi.description: UX/UI designer — component specs, visual review, accessibility

hooks.name: BashToolGuard
hooks.description: Blocks cat/head/tail file reading — enforces COMP-7 mechanically (Tier 3)

hooks.name: TestSuiteGuard
hooks.description: Blocks full test suite (bun test) after 2 runs — enforces DIR-L29 mechanically (Tier 3)

hooks.name: AgentBriefGuard
hooks.description: Validates agent brief templates and enforces ship-active marker

hooks.name: AgentVerdictCapture
hooks.description: Captures agent verdicts and writes to workflow-state.json

hooks.name: AutoVerifyGate
hooks.description: Nudges DA to run verify gate after agent completion

hooks.name: CommitEnforcement
hooks.description: Detects uncommitted changes and UI file changes in agent worktrees

hooks.name: GateEnforcement
hooks.description: Nags on gate failures and blocks Skill calls after max strikes

hooks.name: IssueCloseGuard
hooks.description: Blocks gh issue close without ship-gate PASS and HMAC validation

hooks.name: MergeGuard
hooks.description: Early warning on git merge to main without verify-gate passing

hooks.name: PostCompact
hooks.description: Re-injects critical rules after context window compaction

hooks.name: SpecConformityTrigger
hooks.description: Auto-runs conformity when spec files are modified

hooks.name: SpecSCGuard
hooks.description: Validates new SC lines in spec files have matching patterns

hooks.name: StaleTTLCleanup
hooks.description: Cleans up stale workflow-state.json and ship-active files

hooks.name: TaskCompleted
hooks.description: Quality gates before task completion (tests, uncommitted changes, conformity)

hooks.name: VerifyPhaseLock
hooks.description: Blocks gh issue create during VERIFY phase
